naming_rule_zh: 活动代号统一为 `JZB-[层级]-[年份]-[序号]`（例：`JZB-L1-2028-01`）；中文名 ≤12 字且必须含“共智”或“京张”之一；英文名为首字母大写的短语，不超过 4 个实词，禁止拼音混写；同一层级不得出现两个同名活动，历史名称永久保留不复用。
naming_rule_en: Codes follow `JZB-[tier]-[year]-[index]` (e.g. `JZB-L1-2028-01`); the Chinese name stays within 12 characters and carries “共智” or “京张”; the English name is a Title-Case phrase of at most four content words with no pinyin; names are never reused within a tier or across history.
visual_elements_zh: 基本视觉元素锁定五项：①共字形节点（由“人”字折返线合并为“共”字的轨道母题）；②灰砖—枕木—耐候钢三色材料语言；③里程刻度网格（以 0.5 公里为最小单元）；④站点—道岔—里程三级导视命名；⑤开放参数化数据图形（由铭牌数据集生成，禁止使用不可核查的装饰性 AI 图）。禁止项：不使用企业商标、不使用立体渐变、不使用与铁路遗产无关的赛博朋克符号。
visual_elements_en: Five fixed elements: the co-glyph (a herringbone switch merged into the “共” character), the brick–sleeper–weathering-steel palette, a 0.5 km distance grid, the station–switch–kilometre naming tiers, and parametric data graphics generated from plaque datasets. Prohibited: corporate marks, bevel-and-gradient treatments, cyberpunk imagery unrelated to the railway heritage.
bilingual_templates_zh: 双语传播模板固定为 A 竖版海报（594×841 mm）、B 横版传播图（1920×1080 px）、C 现场易拉宝（850×2000 mm）、D 无障碍电子通告（HTML，单栏、字号可调、对比度 ≥7:1、含替代文本）。四种模板中文在上、英文在下（横版为左中右英），字号比 1:0.82；同一活动两语文案必须由同一人复核，不允许机翻直接发布。
bilingual_templates_en: Four locked templates: A portrait poster (594×841 mm), B landscape social graphic (1920×1080 px), C roll-up (850×2000 mm), D accessible e-notice (single-column HTML, resizable type, contrast ≥7:1, alt text). Chinese leads, English follows (left/right on landscape) at a 1:0.82 type ratio; both languages are proofread by one named reviewer — machine translation is not publishable alone.
content_review_zh: 内容审核三级：①运营方自审（事实与日期）；②区平台合规审（是否含企业承诺、投资额、审批结论、可识别个人数据）；③第三方与公众抽检（铭牌数据可复算性）。任一级否决即撤回，48 小时内公示更正记录。宣传中出现的任何数字必须能回指 `metrics.json` 或图件索引。
content_review_en: Three review gates: operator self-check (facts and dates); district platform compliance check (corporate commitments, investment figures, approval conclusions, identifiable personal data); third-party and public spot audit of plaque reproducibility. Any gate rejects, the asset is withdrawn and a correction is published within 48 hours. Every number in communications must resolve back to metrics.json or the figure index.
asset_archiving_zh: 资产归档责任：源文件（可编辑工程文件＋字体许可声明＋数据集校验和）在活动结束后 30 日内提交区级资产库，保留期 ≥10 年；L1/L4 资产对外以 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 发布（第三方素材按各自许可），原始工程文件不对外；责任人＝当期运营主体品牌负责人，交接时签署资产清单。
asset_archiving_en: Archiving duty: editable source files, font licence statements and dataset checksums are deposited with the district asset library within 30 days of an event and kept for at least ten years. L1/L4 assets are released under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (third-party material under its own terms); working files stay internal. The accountable person is the operator's brand lead, and handover requires a signed inventory.

operations_matrix.subject_zh: 区平台＋轮值共建社区＋高校院系
operations_matrix.resource_zh: 场馆、算力券、场景机会清单、评测席位
operations_matrix.resource_en: Venue, compute vouchers, opportunity list, evaluation seats
operations_matrix.recruit_zh: 开源社区与备案模型团队公开申报，评审公示
operations_matrix.recruit_en: Open call to OSS communities and filed-model teams, published review
operations_matrix.convert_zh: 现场签约改为 90 天试点许可，落地率按次年续约计
operations_matrix.convert_en: On-site signing replaced by 90-day pilot licences; conversion counted at renewal
operations_matrix.review_zh: 参会结构、无障碍满意度、铭牌新增数，年度公开
operations_matrix.review_en: Attendance mix, accessibility satisfaction, new plaques; published yearly

operations_matrix.subject_zh: 重点区运营主体＋入驻团队
operations_matrix.resource_zh: 中试线、测试环、讲解员、开放数据集
operations_matrix.resource_en: Pilot lines, test loop, guides, open datasets
operations_matrix.recruit_zh: 线上预约＋社区组织与学校团体保底名额
operations_matrix.recruit_en: Online booking plus reserved seats for community groups and schools
operations_matrix.convert_zh: 参访转为场景需求单，进入季度清单
operations_matrix.convert_en: Visits become scenario requests entering the quarterly list
operations_matrix.review_zh: 到场构成与重复到访率，季度回看
operations_matrix.review_en: Audience composition and repeat-visit rate reviewed quarterly

operations_matrix.subject_zh: 属地街道＋居民与使用者组织＋设计院系
operations_matrix.subject_en: Street office, resident and user groups, design schools
operations_matrix.resource_zh: 社区活动空间、组件库样品、小额改造资金
operations_matrix.resource_en: Community space, component samples, small-scale retrofit fund
operations_matrix.recruit_zh: 由楼门院长与无障碍使用者组织定向邀约
operations_matrix.recruit_en: Targeted invitations via block representatives and disabled-users groups
operations_matrix.convert_zh: 形成组件库与导视修改建议，纳入年度维护计划
operations_matrix.convert_en: Produces component-library and wayfinding changes folded into the annual maintenance plan
operations_matrix.review_zh: 建议采纳率与实施后满意度回访
operations_matrix.review_en: Adoption rate of suggestions and post-implementation satisfaction

operations_matrix.subject_zh: 区平台＋第三方评测机构＋公众
operations_matrix.resource_zh: 评测环境、数据校验工具、公示渠道
operations_matrix.resource_en: Evaluation environment, data verification tooling, public register
operations_matrix.recruit_zh: 入驻团队自主提交，接受公众质疑
operations_matrix.recruit_en: Self-submission by resident teams, open to public challenge
operations_matrix.convert_zh: 铭牌成为走廊级可信信号，替代招商口号
operations_matrix.convert_en: Plaques act as a corridor-level trust signal replacing leasing slogans
operations_matrix.review_zh: 年度复核，不实即撤销并公示
operations_matrix.review_en: Annual audit; revocation and publication on failure

operations_matrix.subject_zh: 运营主体＋志愿讲解（含居民与退役铁路职工）
operations_matrix.subject_en: Operator plus volunteer guides (residents, retired railway staff)
operations_matrix.resource_zh: 三条半日线、导视系统、语音离线包
operations_matrix.resource_en: Three half-day routes, wayfinding, offline voice packs
operations_matrix.recruit_zh: 讲解员公开招募并培训无障碍服务
operations_matrix.recruit_en: Open recruitment of guides with accessibility training
operations_matrix.convert_zh: 游客转化为志愿者与场景需求提出者
operations_matrix.convert_en: Visitors convert into volunteers and scenario proposers
operations_matrix.review_zh: 线路连续性与断点复测，每半年
operations_matrix.review_en: Route continuity and gap re-survey every six months

status_note_zh: 主体、资金与考核口径均为设计建议，须经区级决策程序与使用者共同确认。
